title: National cancer Institute Common Toxicity critères (NCI-CTC) pour Mucositis
formula:
Selection of the appropriate criterion:

| Appearance | Grade |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | 0 |
| Mucosal erythema | 1 |
| Patchy pseudomembranous reaction, patches generally ≤1.5 cm in diameter and noncontiguous | 2 |
| Confluent pseudomembranous reaction, contiguous patches generally >1.5 cm in diameter) | 3 |
| Necrosis or deep ulceration; may include spontaneous bleeding | 4 |

how_to_use.why: Allows for a common standard language of severity of adverse events due to radiation.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Radiation-related hemoptysis from larynx or pharynx is graded as Grade 4 Mucositis due to radiation in the category Gastrointestinal.
- Radiation-related hemoptysis from thoracic cavity is graded as Grade 4 Hemoptysis in the category Hemorrhage.

more_info:
Interprétation :

Un grade plus élevé est corrélé à une sévérité plus importante.
